Diploma in Engineering/Technology (03-year full-time course) in Computer Science/Information Technology/Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication Engineering/Mechanical Engineering, recognized by AICTE or appropriate statutory authority; Qualifying examination passed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026; Minimum 60% marks in the qualifying examination

content_sections.text: Candidates who have undergone apprenticeship training earlier or are pursuing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Engineering/Technology (07 Nos.): B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent in Computer Science/Information Technology/Electrical Engineering/Electronics & Communication Engineering/Mechanical Engineering, 04-year full-time course, recognized by AICTE/UGC or appropriate statutory authority; General Stream (01 No.): B.Sc./B.Com./B.A. from a recognized University/Institution; Qualifying examination passed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026; Minimum 60% marks in the qualifying examination. Pay: Rs. 12,300. Qualification required: Diploma in Engineering/Technology (03-year full-time course) in Computer Science/Information Technology/Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication Engineering/Mechanical Engineering, recognized by AICTE or appropriate statutory authority; Qualifying examination passed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026; Minimum 60% marks in the qualifying examination. Pay: Rs. 10,900.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Apprenticeship training of 12 months from the date of execution of the Contract of Apprenticeship Apprenticeship Contract ceases automatically after one year; no obligation on ERTL (East) to offer employment Holidays observed by ERTL (East) and other leave as per prevailing BoPT guidelines

content_sections.heading: How Will ERTL (East) Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting for Personal Interview in the ratio of up to 1:5 based on percentage of marks in the qualifying examination, subject to reservation norms Personal Interview Shortlisting ratio up to 1:5 against the respective vacancies Shortlisting based on percentage of marks in the prescribed qualifying examination, subject to reservation norms Screening and selection based on information furnished by the candidate

content_sections.heading: ERTL (East) Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Selection based on marks in qualifying examination and personal interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Valid SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed format, wherever applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ERTL (East) Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal before applying. Apply online through the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php. Apply by 15-11-2026.
